ceu: ✦ The conjunction between Venus and Pluto

s.k: Share a dream with someone who believes in it.
t: The Moon passes through your area of friends and projects. Good company gives you energy today.
Venus and Pluto are together in {S:10}: affection and harmony, depth and transformation, all focused on friends and plans for the future. Listen to what this area has been asking of you for a while.
With Mars retrograde in your romance sector, frustration fades when you change the way you act.
s.d: Do a friend a favour without expecting anything in return.

s.k: Your goals ask for a firm step.
t: Today work and reputation carry emotional weight. Praise or criticism touches you more than usual.
Venus and Pluto are together in {S:10}: affection and harmony, depth and transformation, all focused on your career and your goals. What you do here today has more strength than usual.
With Mars retrograde in your home and family sector, channel your energy into finishing what you started.
s.d: Say no to a task that is not yours.

s.k: A day to learn and broaden your horizons.
t: With the Moon in your house of wisdom, the day asks for meaning: ask yourself where you want to go, not just how.
Venus and Pluto are together in {S:10}: affection and harmony, depth and transformation, all focused on study, travel and broad horizons. A decision made today will stand on firm ground.
With Mars retrograde in your communication sector, haste holds you back more than it helps, so review your strategy.
s.d: Accept an invitation that is different from usual.

s.k: Trust is the word of the day.
t: The Moon touches intimacy and strong bonds. Open up to those who deserve it, and only to those who deserve it.
Venus and Pluto are together in {S:10}: affection and harmony, depth and transformation, all focused on intimacy and what you share with others. Focus, and leave the rest for tomorrow.
With Mars retrograde in your money sector, frustration fades when you change the way you act.
s.d: Speak frankly about a matter you keep avoiding.

s.k: Today the other person is your mirror.
t: A good day for agreements and serious conversations with those who walk beside you. Be clear and fair.
Venus and Pluto are together in {S:10}: affection and harmony, depth and transformation, all focused on relationships and partnerships. The sky points the way: all you have to do is follow it.
With Mars retrograde in your self-image sector, channel your energy into finishing what you started.
s.d: Give way on something small to gain on something big.

s.k: Organise the day and the day will organise you.
t: The Moon passes through your area of routine and health. Organising the day is the best way to make the most of it.
Venus and Pluto are together in {S:10}: affection and harmony, depth and transformation, all focused on routine, daily work and health. A new beginning may be born from here.
With Mars retrograde in your inner life sector, haste holds you back more than it helps, so review your strategy.
s.d: Book that test or check-up you keep putting off.

s.k: Your heart wants a celebration and a little light.
t: Today your heart is lighter and more playful. It is a good day for romance and for small pleasures.
Venus and Pluto are together in {S:10}: affection and harmony, depth and transformation, all focused on pleasure, creativity and romance. This is where your strength lies today.
With Mars retrograde in your friendship sector, frustration fades when you change the way you act.
s.d: Allow yourself a sweet or a treat without guilt.

s.k: The heart of the day is at home.
t: With the Moon in your house of roots, old memories may return. Welcome them without getting stuck in them.
Venus and Pluto are together in {S:10}: affection and harmony, depth and transformation, all focused on home and family. Put your willpower at the service of what matters.
With Mars retrograde in your career sector, channel your energy into finishing what you started.
s.d: Tidy a drawer or a corner of the house that bothers you.

s.k: One conversation can change the course of the day.
t: The Moon livens up short trips and contact with siblings, neighbours and colleagues. A day on the move.

Venus and Pluto are together in {S:10}: affection and harmony, depth and transformation, all focused on conversations, contacts and short trips. Everything is concentrated in one place, so give it your full attention.
With Mars retrograde in your horizons sector, haste holds you back more than it helps, so review your strategy.
s.d: Take a different route on your usual way.

s.k: Look at what you have, not at what you lack.
t: Today's emotions run through your wallet and through what you consider yours. Protect what you have built, without closing yourself off.
Venus and Pluto are together in {S:10}: affection and harmony, depth and transformation, all focused on your money and what you value. Do not scatter yourself: one goal at a time.
With Mars retrograde in your intimacy sector, frustration fades when you change the way you act.
s.d: Treat yourself to a small comfort that costs almost nothing.

s.k: A day to put yourself first.
t: The Moon passes through your sign today and leaves your emotions close to the surface: it is a day to listen to yourself first and decide later.
Venus and Pluto are together in {S:10}: affection and harmony, depth and transformation, all focused on your image and your personal energy. It is a good day to start something in this area.
With Mars retrograde in your relationships sector, channel your energy into finishing what you started.
s.d: Wear a colour you really love and notice how it changes your mood.

s.k: A day to recharge on the inside.
t: Today sensitivity is high and tiredness may appear. Sleep well and protect yourself from noise.
Venus and Pluto are together in {S:10}: affection and harmony, depth and transformation, all focused on rest and your inner life. There is more intensity than usual, so take it easy.
With Mars retrograde in your daily routine sector, haste holds you back more than it helps, so review your strategy.
s.d: Switch off your phone an hour before bed.
